**Discussion**

Discuss these questions:

•	Which population group in our city is most at risk during a heat wave? Why?
(Use: risk factors, elderly, homeless, outdoor workers, children, pregnant women, chronic disease, prescribed medication)
•	What is the most dangerous consequence of heat exposure?
(Use: kidney failure, heart attack, brain damage, heat stroke, dehydration, death)
•	What is the most important prevention message that everyone should remember?
(Use: staying hydrated, to stay cool, to counteract fluid loss, to abstain from high-intensity exercise)
•	How can we improve our community's response to heat waves in the future?
(Use: health care industry, health implications, hospitalizations, emergency medicine, public education)
•	What was the most challenging part of creating this heat wave response plan?
(Use: to deal with extreme heat, to protect oneself, to get to a cool place, to take action)
